content: Humankind did not weave the web of life; we are merely a single strand within it.
author: Native American Proverbs
sourceWork: Attributed to Chief Seattle (Suquamish & Duwamish) Oral Tradition
explanation: Arrogant industrial hubris treats human beings as monarchs standing outside nature, free to pollute rivers and slaughter species with impunity. But whatever poison you pour into the living web of life, you inevitably pour directly into your own bloodstream. We are all kin.
practicalInsight: Treat every living creature, water source, and plant today with the respect due to a member of your own extended family.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your daily consumption are you acting as if you are separate from the living web of the earth?
